feed.title: SeedanceCheap Creator Cookbook
feed.subtitle: Original AI films, editing breakdowns, and reproducible video checks from the SeedanceCheap team.

entry.title: The Last Key
entry.summary: A stranger holds out a key identical to Maya’s. Watch both chapters as one short film, then get the editable cast sheets and a two-shot continuity exercise.

entry.title: Same frames. One goes silent.
entry.summary: Watch the seven-second synthetic MP4 comparison. Both samples show the same 12 picture frames. The reference has 24 audio packets and a brief tone. The simulated drop has zero audio packets. The guide includes a downloadable test file and the ffprobe command.

entry.title: End the scene on the reveal
entry.summary: Compare the original AI dinner scene with a shorter cut of the same footage. See where the reaction and reveal land in each version.

entry.title: Try three beats in one action shot
entry.summary: A parcel falls, the courier catches it, and a second parcel starts to slide. Load the exercise into the free scene notes and plan a wide shot that keeps both boxes and the courier's hands visible.

entry.title: The Cherry Stays
entry.summary: Watch a 10.25-second AI action edit and jump to the restored cherry. The breakdown shows how a 14-frame insert carries a prop across a costume change.
